title: Great bathmat!
text: Great bathmat!. Nice looking, comfortable, cushy bath mat.  Washes well, comes in several sizes and was reasonable priced.  Was shipped very quickly.  Overall, a very good product.

product_metadata.title: Seafoam Blue Memory Foam Bath Mat :, Non Skid (21" x 34")
description: The perfect addition to your private escape, these Bath Mats add a touch of luxury to any bathroom. These mats get their cushioned feel from a soothing layer of memory foam that is covered in a durable microfiber. Add to that a safety first non-skid latex backing and you end up with a beautiful and smart mat that feels as good as it looks. Bring one home and indulge in a private spa experience today!
